falsifiable_hypothesis: A fixed within-drug non-increasing projection of the purchased dose observations reduces measurement-order violations enough to improve complete held-patient prediction risk.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across the two separately costed 64-well orientations; never average predictions

method_summary: Keep every fitting-slice bandwidth-0.7 acquisition plan unchanged. For each sample, orientation and drug independently, order its two or three purchased normalized-viability values by native concentration and apply the unique equal-weight Euclidean projection onto a non-increasing sequence using deterministic PAVA. Use only these projected paid values for the candidate own-drug context and bandwidth-0.7 residual features; use raw paid values for the incumbent control. Do not clip values, tune projection strength, alter targets, add wells or inspect Protected22.
